lines.en: I waddle forward.
My webbed feet tread the waterside.

lines.zh: 我的脖子一前一后地伸。
lines.en: My neck pumps forward and back.

lines.zh: 我从围栏这一头走到那头。
lines.en: I walk the pen from this end to that.
I peck at the mud.
My gait isn't very steady.
I go around the puddles.
I've walked this circuit many times.
My short tail sways side to side.
I stop and look around.

lines.zh: 木头围栏外面我看不到。
lines.en: I can't see past the wooden fence.
This duckbill of mine is for tender shoots.

lines.zh: 我在食槽边站了一会儿。
lines.en: I stand by the trough a while.

lines.zh: 我这只鸭子，走起路来还得摆尾。
lines.en: A duck this size still waddles when it walks.
I stand by the fence.
I preen the water off my chest.
The sun bakes the boards hot.
I lift my head and let out a call.

lines.zh: 这条围栏是我最熟的地方。
lines.en: This pen is what I know best.
I settle slowly into the grass nest.

lines.zh: 我这只鸭，是从机器里孵的。
lines.en: This duck was hatched in a machine.
I turn sideways to the sun.

lines.zh: 我在围栏这头走到那头，脚蹼啪嗒响。
lines.en: I pace the fence, webbed feet slapping.
I don't much care.
There's little sound in the pen.
I'll just stay crouched.
I tuck my feet beneath me.
Wind comes through the board gaps.
You're looking at me from outside the fence.
This is the first I've seen of you.
I tilt my head and look back.
Is that food in your hand?
I take a step toward the rail.
The grass outside tastes better.
How did you get in?
You're standing at the gate.
I can't fly.
I shuffle up to you.
I look at you through the rail.
Your shadow falls on the trough.
That struck my back.
I tipped to one side.
Several feathers came loose.
That pain is fairly large.
I back to the boards.
I can still lean on the rail.
I shake and mud spatters.
This flat bill actually has teeth.
I'm clumsy; I can't dodge.
Stop hitting; I'll hide in the grass.
Is that a tuft of grass in your hand?
I know those leaves.
Hold it out toward me.
I can't reach past the rail.
Don't hold your hand that high.
The grass still holds moisture.
I stretch my neck as far as I can.
Step back half a pace and I'll reach it.
I won't snatch.
Just leave it there.
You bumped me inside the pen.
I wobbled and nearly sat down.
My feet slid on the mud.
Don't push me.
I back up along the fence.
We both hit the wooden rail.
The board rang.
You backed off to the rails.
There's a new footprint on the ground.
One shake, and dust falls off my feathers.
I'm alone in this pen.
The duck bill nuzzles the dirt.
I can't even call properly.
Stand outside the rails.

lines.zh: 我长得像鸭子，腿却很长。
lines.en: I look like a duck, but these legs are long.
I've settled down.
The boards are between us.
Shadows move outside.

lines.zh: 我脑子里没有别的想法。
lines.en: There's nothing else on my mind.
I'll just crouch.
I put my bill to it and pecked.
Hard, doesn't look like food.

lines.zh: 它就在泥里，我用嘴拨了拨。
lines.en: It lies in the mud; I nudge it with my beak.
Did you drop this?
It's in the mud.
I nudge it with my flat bill.
This is not food; I can tell.
I carry it off slowly.
It's under the rail.
You'd better get it yourself.
Something's moving outside the fence.

lines.zh: 我把头转过去，刷怪蛋的味道。
lines.en: I turn my head; that smells of a spawn egg.
Someone outside.
I'm in the pen. I can't run far.
My webbed feet slip in the mud.
I retreat to the corner.
Boards block this corner.
You came in from there.
The gate is still open.
Which way should I run?
I run in circles along the fence.
My wings opened once.
But I didn't fly.
You're getting closer.
I run along the fence.
The boards knock, one after another.
You're not far behind.
I run in circles.
This pen is too small.
I turn to the other side.
Your shadow falls on the fence.
My feet faltered a moment.

lines.zh: 鸭一样的嘴，啃蕨叶正好。
lines.en: A duck bill is just right for ferns.
Running more won't get me out.
I bucked against the gate.
The gate didn't open.
I retreat to the very back.
Only this patch is left.
I hug the boards and turn.
I run behind the trough.
You've blocked the gate.
My short wings flap in your face.
Wing wind can't hurt me.
My flat bill pecks you.
My bill is soft.

lines.zh: 这一下软绵绵，连皮都没破。
lines.en: A soft hit; not even skin broke.
I throw my whole body at you.
I'm the one who bounced back.
I kick with my feet.
Mud splashed onto you.
This is all I can do.
I spread my wings and fold them.
Head low, I butt with my flat bill.
I peck at your boot.

lines.zh: 一头撞上去，我自己也晕。
lines.en: I ram it and daze myself too.
I back into the fence corner.
I really can't run anymore.
I open my eyes in the pen.
The wood still smells the same.
The grass outside is taller than me.
I push myself up and shake off straw.
I walk a circle along the boards.
There's nothing else shaped like me.

lines.zh: 我不知道自己从哪个蛋来的。
lines.en: I don't know which egg I came from.

lines.zh: 有人说我是从机器里出来的。
lines.en: Some say I came out of a machine.
I can't remember.
I only know this pen.
I bend my long neck down.
It's bright outside the pen.
I don't dare go out.
At least there are boards here.

lines.zh: 我长得像鸭子，却是恐龙。
lines.en: I look like a duck, but I'm a dinosaur.
I take two slow steps.
Fire neared and the boards caught first.
I fell once and got back up.
This puddle is deeper than I thought.
The blast knocked the rails askew.

lines.zh: 一支箭扎进我旁边的板子。
lines.en: An arrow sank into the board beside me.

lines.zh: 一道光打过来，我看不清了。
lines.en: A flash came and I couldn't see.

lines.zh: 食槽是空的，我一直在刨。
lines.en: The trough is empty. I keep scraping at it.

lines.zh: 雷声把我吓得缩了起来。
lines.en: The thunder made me crouch down.

lines.zh: 这里没有地，我也不见了。
lines.en: No ground here, and I'm gone too.
